caption:
Eight of Allah's names in one verse

He is the Granter of Security and the Watcher over all. Whatever kept you on edge today, call on Him by these names tonight.

Surah Al-Hashr 59:23

Which of these names will you call Him by tonight?

#namesofallah #asmaulhusna #surahhashr #quranreels

Recitation: Abdul Basit Abdus-Samad
alt_text: He is Allah; none has the right to be worshiped except Him, the Sovereign, the Most Holy, the Most Perfect, the Granter of Security, the Watcher over all, the All-Mighty, the Compeller, the Supreme. Glory be to Allah far above what they associate with Him (Surah Al-Hashr 59:23)
